title: Question statistics
subtitle: What customers ask, and how well it is answered
empty: No questions recorded in this range.
attentionHint: Flagged rows have a high handoff rate or low confidence — these are the topics worth improving in the knowledge base first.
snapshotNote: Figures come from daily snapshots, so they remain available after conversation logs are purged.
staleWarning: No question data since {{date}} ({{days}} days). The table shows what was aggregated up to then.
neverAggregated: No question snapshot has been written yet.

channel.title: Where conversations come from
channel.name: Channel
channel.hint: Median first: one group room of several hundred turns pulls the average away from every conversation it describes.

agents.name: Name
agents.emptyHuman: No conversation reached a person in this range.
agents.aiHint: Sessions with no agent pinned are counted under the tenant default, which is the agent that answered them.
agents.humanHint: Counted from conversations assigned to each person, not from a stored score.

resolution.title: How conversations ended
resolution.headline: {{rate}} of ended conversations resolved ({{resolved}} of {{ended}}).
resolution.hint: The same definition the customer-journey report uses. A conversation where the customer spoke last is not resolved — the question was still open.

hours.title: When customers write
hours.empty: No customer messages in this range.
hours.zoneDefault: Times shown in {{zone}} — no timezone is set for this tenant, so the peak may not be the local one.

retentionNote: Computed from the conversation log, so this view reaches back only as far as the log is kept.

access.funnelTitle: How often the widget was shown, opened and talked to
access.funnelSubtitle: Impressions count widget loads; access counts panel opens.
access.defaultAgentNote: Sessions with no agent pinned are counted as “Default agent”.
access.pathNote: Query strings are not stored (privacy). Counted by path.
access.neverOpened: Shown often enough, opened by nobody — check the launcher is visible.
access.since: Paths and opens are collected from {{date}}; earlier impressions have neither.
access.appModeNote: App (WebView) mode starts with the panel open, so impressions equal access there.

journey.title: The order customers went through
journey.subtitle: The first three nest inside each other. The last four are not exclusive; their base is conversations.
journey.notExclusive: An escalated conversation is still rated and still ends — these can sum past the conversation count.
journey.collectionNote: Impressions and access are collected from 2026-09-20; earlier ranges start at conversations.
